hints.title: Every palindrome has a center
hints.body: A palindrome expands symmetrically around either one character or a gap between two characters.

hints.title: Try all centers
hints.body: There are `2n - 1` centers: one per character and one per gap.

hints.title: Expand while equal
hints.body: Move outward while both characters match, then record the longest range.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
best = empty range
for center in range(n):
    check odd palindrome around center
    check even palindrome around center and center + 1
return text[best]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
